threads.body: The streaming return above bypasses this observation handler. With `stream: true`, the same request used by the new observation test still selects the first offered tool (`get_weather`) and emits `call_mock_001`, rather than `final_answer` with `call_mock_002`. A streaming client therefore continues the repeated-tool loop, although the new scenarios use non-streaming requests. Apply the observation-aware selection and call numbering in `_stream_tool_call` too, and extend the regression test to cover both response modes.
